summary: Red Hat Virtualization credentials for the oVirt4 inventory set OVIRT_URL, OVIRT_USERNAME and OVIRT_PASSWORD; the URL must include ovirt-engine/api, the username needs the domain profile (user@ovirt.host.com), and an optional CA file path.
